cases.title: Initiate Drag Event and Capture Product Details
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true' and data-testid='product-item-1') initiates a drag event and successfully captures the product's title and price for transfer.

cases.title: Drop product item into drop area to add to cart and update display
cases.description: Verify that dragging and dropping a product item (e.g., data-testid='product-item-1') into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') adds it to the cart and automatically updates the cart display with the product title in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Support adding different and repeated products to the cart
cases.description: Verify that the system supports adding both different products and repeated products into the drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') and correctly updates the cart display elements (.box1, .box2, .box3) accordingly.

cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Price with Currency Symbol and Formatting
cases.description: Verify that the system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays it in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and explicit behaviors have been fully analyzed. The proposed cases cover all normal paths, edge cases, and distinct scenarios defined in the requirements without any gaps, blockers, or redundancies.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1 describes dragging a product item (li element) to initiate a drag event, capturing the product's title and price. Atomic behaviors: 1) Initiate drag event when dragging a product item (li with draggable=true); 2) Capture product title for transfer; 3) Capture product price for transfer. Only a Normal test scenario is warranted as no explicit abnormal paths or boundaries are mentioned. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3 describes dropping product items into a drop area to add to the cart and updating cart displays (.box1, .box2, .box3) for different and repeated products. Atomic behaviors: 1) Allow dragging and dropping product items into the drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'); 2) Update cart display automatically upon dropping (product title in .box2, unit price in .box3, quantity in .box1); 3) Support adding different products; 4) Support adding repeated products. Only a Normal test scenario is warranted. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5 describes calculating the total price by summing all cart product prices, formatting to two decimal places with the currency symbol, and displaying it in <div id='allMoney'>. Atomic behaviors: 1) Calculate total price by summing prices of all products in the cart; 2) Format total to two decimal places with currency symbol; 3) Display total in <div id='allMoney'>. Only a Normal test scenario is warranted.

coverage.feedback: The accepted test cases adequately cover the explicit requirements without introducing excess, overgeneration, or repetition. G-001 tests dragging and capturing product details (R-1), G-002 and G-003 test dropping products into the drop area and updating display elements for both single, different, and repeated items (R-3), and G-004 verifies the total price calculation and formatting in the designated element (R-5). No coverage gaps or speculative edge cases were found.
